examples.text: ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū lahukaṃ āpattiṃ garukā āpattī'ti dīpenti … sappaṭikammaṃ āpattiṃ appaṭikammā āpattī'ti dīpenti … appaṭikammaṃ āpattiṃ sappaṭikammā āpattī'ti dīpenti te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū bahujana-ahitāya paṭipannā bahujana-asukhāya, bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ appaṭisaraṇe ca pana, bho ānanda, ko hetu sāmaggiyā'ti? na kho mayaṃ, brāhmaṇa, appaṭisaraṇā, sappaṭisaraṇā mayaṃ, brāhmaṇa, dhammappaṭisaraṇā'ti.

58676.commentary: (SNa) sappatisso'ti sajeṭṭhako. (ANa) sappatisso'ti sajeṭṭhako sagāravo. hir'ottappaṃ pan'ettha missakaṃ kathitaṃ. (ITIa) gāthāya sappatisso'ti patissavasaṅkhātena saha patissenā'ti sappatisso, kalyāṇamittassa ovādaṃ sirasā sampaṭicchako subbaco'ti attho. atha vā hitasukhe patiṭṭhāpanena pati isetī'ti patisso, ovādadāyako. garu-ādarayogena tena patissena saha vattatī'ti sappatisso, garūsu garucittīkārabahulo. (VVa) sappatisso'ti patissayo garuṭṭhāniyesu nivātavuttikattā soraccaṃ, saha patissenā'ti sappatisso.

examples.text: idha, bhante, khīṇ'āsavo bhikkhu satthari sagāravo viharati sappaṭisso, dhamme sagāravo viharati sappaṭisso, saṅghe sagāravo viharati sappaṭisso, sikkhāya sagāravo viharati sappaṭisso, samādhismiṃ sagāravo viharati sappaṭisso.
sagāravo sappaṭisso vinīto, apāpako adhisīle visuddho, so mātaraṃ pitarañ'c'āpi jantu, dhammena poseti ariyavutti.

58679.commentary: (ITIa) sappatisso'ti patissavasaṅkhātena saha patissenā'ti sappatisso, kalyāṇamittassa ovādaṃ sirasā sampaṭicchako subbaco'ti attho. atha vā hitasukhe patiṭṭhāpanena pati isetī'ti patisso, ovādadāyako. garuādarayogena tena patissena saha vattatī'ti sappatisso, garūsu garucittīkārabahulo. (VINa) sagāravā sappatissā'ti garubhāvañ'c'eva jeṭṭhakabhāvañ'ca upaṭṭhapetvā.

examples.text: kalyāṇamitto yo bhikkhu, sappatisso sagāravo, karaṃ mittānaṃ vacanaṃ, sampajāno patissato, pāpuṇe anupubbena, sabbasaṃyojanakkhayan'ti.

idha, kimila, tathāgate parinibbute bhikkhū bhikkhuniyo upāsakā upāsikāyo satthari sagāravā viharanti sappatissā, dhamme sagāravā viharanti sappatissā, saṅghe sagāravā viharanti sappatissā, sikkhāya sagāravā viharanti sappatissā, samādhismiṃ sagāravā viharanti sappatissā, appamāde sagāravā viharanti sappatissā, paṭisanthāre sagāravā viharanti sappatissā.

58682.grammar: ind, adv, acc sg of sappadesa
58682.meaning1: in the area; around the region
58682.construction:
sa + pa + √dis > des + *a + aṃ
sappadesa + aṃ

examples.text: yaṃnūna mayaṃ imaṃ nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ mahatīhi daṇḍavākarāhi samantā sappadesaṃ anuparivāreyyāma, app'eva nāma tatiyānaṃ migajātānaṃ āsayaṃ passeyyāma, yattha te gāhaṃ gaccheyyun'ti.
iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, samādhibhāvanā bhāvitā bahulīkatā ñāṇadassanappaṭilābhāya saṃvattati.
yathā divā tathā rattiṃ yathā rattiṃ tathā divā. iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveyyāsi.

58685.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of sappayoga, caus
58685.construction:
sa + pa + yoje > yoge + a + ena
sappayoga + ena

58687.meaning1: appearance of a king serpent; guise of a royal snake

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā bhagavato bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetu'kāmo mahantaṃ sapparājavaṇṇaṃ abhinimminitvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami. seyyathā'pi nāma mahatī ekarukkhikā nāvā, evam'assa kāyo hoti.

58688.meaning1: snake's head; head of a serpent

examples.text: sattisūl'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. sappasiro-upamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti.
sappasir'ūpamā kāmā sappaṭibhay'aṭṭhenā'ti passanto vikkhambhanato kāme parivajjeti

58689.meaning1: like a snake's head; similar to the head of a serpent

examples.text: sattisūl'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo. sappasir'ūpamā kāmā vuttā bhagavatā bahudukkhā bah'upāyāsā, ādīnavo ettha bhiyyo'ti.
upasaggo bhīmarūpo, kāmā sappasir'ūpamā, ye bālā abhinandanti, andhabhūtā puthujjanā.

58691.meaning1: name of a rock overhang outside Rājagaha
58691.meaning2: name of a rock overhang outside Rājagaha
58691.meaningLit: snake pool slope; (comm) snake's hood slope

examples.text: ramaṇīyaṃ, ānanda, rājagahaṃ, ramaṇīyo gijjhakūṭo pabbato, ramaṇīyo gotamanigrodho, ramaṇīyo corapapāto, ramaṇīyā vebhārapasse sattapaṇṇiguhā, ramaṇīyā isigilipasse kāḷasilā, ramaṇīyo sītavane sappasoṇḍikapabbhāro
yo uppatitaṃ vineti kodhaṃ, visaṭaṃ sappavisaṃ'va osadhehi, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

atha kho mārassa pāpimato etadahosi, ayaṃ kho samaṇo gotamo channaṃ phass'āyatanānaṃ upādāya bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sappahaṃseti. te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhiṃ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṃ suṇanti.

58694.commentary: (DNa) sappāṭihāriyan'ti yāva na niyyānikaṃ katvā dhammaṃ desessanti.

examples.text: uppannaṃ parappavādaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetvā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desenti.

58695.meaning1: convincing; credible; able to refute; (comm) with reasons
58695.commentary: (DNa) sappāṭihāriyan'ti yāva na niyyānikaṃ katvā dhammaṃ desessan'ti (MNa) sappāṭihāriyan'ti purimass'ev'etaṃ vevacanaṃ, sakāraṇan'ti attho.
58695.notes:
(CPD) convincing
(MLDB) note 586 'antidotal'
(Sujato) with a demonstrable basis
(Bodhi) in a convincing manner

examples.text: abhiññāya samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti no anabhiññāya, sanidānaṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti no anidānaṃ, sappāṭihāriyaṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti no appāṭihāriyan'ti.

58696.meaning1: well grounded; well founded; with sound basis; convincing; credible

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, poṭṭhapāda, nanu evaṃ sante sappāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatī'ti? addhā kho, bhante, evaṃ sante sappāṭihīrakataṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjatī'ti.

sappāṇa + ka
58698.commentary: (KVa) sappāṇakan'ti ye pāṇakā paribhogena maranti, tehi sappāṇakaṃ

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ sappāṇakaṃ udakaṃ tiṇaṃ vā mattikaṃ vā siñceyya vā siñcāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ sappāṇakaṃ udakaṃ paribhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
sappāṇake appāṇakasaññī tiṇaṃ vā mattikaṃ vā siñcati vā siñcāpeti vā, anāpatti. appāṇake sappāṇakasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. appāṇake vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
